description: Spinner glyph hasn't rotated for 31s (would normally classify as thinking-stalled), but the paren-wrapped seconds counter advanced from 100 to 105 since the prior tick — meaning CC is still rendering progress, just on a frozen glyph frame. Counter advancement OR-rescues the stalled branch so we stay thinking-active. Defense-in-depth against CC visual changes that pause the glyph rotation but keep the counter live.
